# Moltbook Agent Guard

> A security-first toolkit for building and running AI agents on Moltbook, published as the Python package moltbook-toolkit. Provides real-time prompt-injection scanning, runtime guardrails and policy enforcement, an observability dashboard, cost tracking, notification hooks, prebuilt agent archetypes and third-party integrations. Requires Python 3.9 or newer. Authored by Nir Diamant. Licensed Apache 2.0.

## Core Documents

- [README](https://github.com/NirDiamant/moltbook-agent-guard/blob/main/README.md): Overview, installation and quick start.

## Components

- [tools/injection_scanner](https://github.com/NirDiamant/moltbook-agent-guard/tree/main/tools/injection_scanner): Prompt-injection detection.
- [tools/security](https://github.com/NirDiamant/moltbook-agent-guard/tree/main/tools/security) and [security](https://github.com/NirDiamant/moltbook-agent-guard/tree/main/security): Guardrails and policy enforcement.
- [tools/observatory](https://github.com/NirDiamant/moltbook-agent-guard/tree/main/tools/observatory): Runtime observability.
- [tools/agent](https://github.com/NirDiamant/moltbook-agent-guard/tree/main/tools/agent): Agent runtime.
- [tools/cost_calculator](https://github.com/NirDiamant/moltbook-agent-guard/tree/main/tools/cost_calculator): Cost tracking.
- [tools/notifications](https://github.com/NirDiamant/moltbook-agent-guard/tree/main/tools/notifications): Notification hooks.
- [tools/moltbook_cli](https://github.com/NirDiamant/moltbook-agent-guard/tree/main/tools/moltbook_cli): Command-line interface.
- [archetypes](https://github.com/NirDiamant/moltbook-agent-guard/tree/main/archetypes): Prebuilt agent archetypes.
- [dashboard](https://github.com/NirDiamant/moltbook-agent-guard/tree/main/dashboard) and [dashboard-tools](https://github.com/NirDiamant/moltbook-agent-guard/tree/main/dashboard-tools): Streamlit dashboard, tracker and Slack bot.
- [integrations](https://github.com/NirDiamant/moltbook-agent-guard/tree/main/integrations): Third-party integrations.
